description: An API for accessing Advisory Notifications in Google Cloud

GoogleCloudAdvisorynotificationsV1Notifi.description: A notification object for notifying customers about security and privacy issues.

name.description: The resource name of the notification. Format: organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}/notifications/{notification} or projects/{project}/locations/{location}/notifications/{notification}.

subject.description: The subject line of the notification.

createTime.description: Output only. Time the notification was created.

messages.description: A list of messages in the notification.

GoogleCloudAdvisorynotificationsV1Attach.description: Attachment with specific information about the issue.

csv.description: A CSV file attachment. Max size is 10 MB.

enabled.description: Whether the associated NotificationType is enabled.

GoogleCloudAdvisorynotificationsV1Csv.description: A representation of a CSV file attachment, as a list of column headers and a list of data rows.

headers.description: The list of headers for data columns in a CSV file.

dataRows.description: The list of data rows in a CSV file, as string arrays rather than as a single comma-separated string.

GoogleCloudAdvisorynotificationsV1CsvCsv.description: A representation of a single data row in a CSV file.

entries.description: The data entries in a CSV file row, as a string array rather than a single comma-separated string.

text.description: The text content of the message body.

GoogleCloudAdvisorynotificationsV1Messag.description: A message which contains notification details.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the settings to retrieve. Format: organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}/settings or projects/{projects}/locations/{location}/settings.

notificationSettings.description: Required. Map of each notification type and its settings to get/set all settings at once. The server will validate the value for each notification type.

etag.description: Required. Fingerprint for optimistic concurrency returned in Get requests. Must be provided for Update requests. If the value provided does not match the value known to the server, ABORTED will be thrown, and the client should retry the read-modify-write cycle.

GoogleCloudAdvisorynotificationsV1Text.description: A text object containing the English text and its localized copies.
